hints: Add 35 mL of base. If base only watered the acid down, the pH would stay below 7. What does the pH reading say?

Water only spreads the acid out, like adding water to juice. Base reacts with the acid. Their particles join up to make water, so the acid gets used up. Once all the acid is gone, extra base makes the solution basic.
Set the base to exactly 25 mL and look for pH 7. Then add 35 mL. What happens to the pH now?
